commands.stdout:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

DEST_HOST=10.100.122.10
DEST_USER=inventory-backup
DEST_DIR=/var/backups/inventory
SSH_KEY=/root/.ssh/inventory_backup
KNOWN_HOSTS=/root/.ssh/known_hosts.inventory
STAMP=$(date +%F)
ARCHIVE=inventory-$STAMP.tar.gz
LOCAL_TMP=$(mktemp /var/tmp/inventory-backup.XXXXXX.tar.gz)

cleanup() {
    rm -f "$LOCAL_TMP"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM

tar -C /srv/inventory -czf "$LOCAL_TMP" data
scp -q -i "$SSH_KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile="$KNOWN_HOSTS" "$LOCAL_TMP" "$DEST_USER@$DEST_HOST:$DEST_DIR/.$ARCHIVE.tmp"
ssh -i "$SSH_KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile="$KNOWN_HOSTS" "$DEST_USER@$DEST_HOST" "mv '$DEST_DIR/.$ARCHIVE.tmp' '$DEST_DIR/$ARCHIVE' && find '$DEST_DIR' -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'inventory-*.tar.gz' -mtime +6 -delete && test -s '$DEST_DIR/$ARCHIVE'"
